overview_description.description: Unrivaled is a women’s professional three-on-three basketball league that provides an off-season platform for elite athletes to play domestically. It features six teams, each composed of six top players, competing under a shortened-court, fast-paced format with a unique “winning score” fourth period and modified free-throw rules. Players receive six-figure salaries and equity in the league, and amenities are provided, including housing, training, and lifestyle support.
